title: 하비의 마지막 로맨스
bench_name: 없음 — 10-27 한국어 결말포함 리뷰 없음(43만 wPzMYy9xdFk 는 「비우티풀」이었음). 사용자 「후킹없이 이야기의 흐름데로」 → 영화 순서대로
ctx: 영화 「Last Chance Harvey」(2008, 한국 개봉 「하비의 마지막 로맨스」, 감독 Joel Hopkins). Dustin Hoffman as Harvey Shine, a divorced New York jingle composer whose career is slipping; he flies to London for his daughter Susan's wedding. Emma Thompson as Kate Walker, a lonely middle-aged London airport survey worker who looks after her anxious mother Maggie (Eileen Atkins) who suspects her Polish neighbour. Liane Balaban as Susan, Harvey's daughter; Kathy Baker as Jean, Harvey's ex-wife; James Brolin as Brian, Jean's husband and Susan's stepfather, whom Susan asks to walk her down the aisle; Richard Schiff as Marvin, Harvey's boss who fires him by phone. Harvey misses his flight back, loses his job, meets Kate in the airport bar, they walk around London, she convinces him to go to the wedding reception where he gives a speech; they spend the next day together; he misses their meeting because of a heart arrhythmia episode; Kate is hurt; he finds her at her writing class and they reconcile.

cold_ok.S16 이번 건 꼭 따내, 하: 하비가 돌아오겠다고 버티자 사장이 마지막 경고로 하는 말 — 바로 뒤 「더는 기회 없어」
cold_ok.S38 에이, 나도 이제 다: 바로 앞 나레가 가족은 다 다른 집에 묵는다고 말함 — 괜찮은 척이 그대로 보이는 장면
